FILE

Information has been obtained that a secret conference was held between 5 p.m. and 9 p.m., May 13 on the 2nd floor of the New Asia Hotel, Tiendong Road, by representatives of the Japanese Military and Naval Authorities, consular officials, the "Reformed Government" and the Shanghai Municipal Administrative Office, including the notorious Tai Ho lake "Pirate Queen" Wong Pah-mei. A heavy cordon of the Japanese gendarmerie and members of the Japanese Special Service Corps was thrown around the building.

According to information gathered from various sources, the meeting discussed and passed the following resolutions:-

1) That, when necessary, force be used in dealing with the problems of the Shanghai Maritime Customs and the Shanghai Special District Court.

2) That definite measures be devised with a view to inducing the Settlement Authorities to suppress rigidly the activities of espionage agents in Chinese government service.

3) That a reward of $5,000 be issued to the personnel of the Japanese Special Service Section for good work performed.

4) That the remnants of Miss Wong Pah-mei and Colonel Ting Sih-shan (丁雪山) in the Tai Ho region be reorganized into a "Paontui", the arms to be supplied by the Japanese Military.

5) That efforts at creating terrorism in the International Settlement be continued in order to embarrass the Shanghai Municipal Council.

档案

据获情报，5月13日下午5时至9时，日本海陆军当局代表、领事官员、“维新政府”以及上海市政办公厅的代表，包括臭名昭著的太湖“海盗女王”黄八妹，在天潼路新亚大酒店二楼举行了一次秘密会议。日本宪兵队和日本特务机关成员在建筑物周围部署了严密的警戒线。

根据从各方收集的情报，会议讨论并通过了以下决议：-

1) 在处理上海海关和上海特区法院的问题时，如有必要，使用武力。

2) 制定明确措施，旨在促使租界当局严厉镇压在中国政府服务中的间谍活动。

3) 向日本特务科人员发放5,000元奖金，以表彰其出色工作。

4) 将黄八妹小姐和丁雪山上校在太湖地区的残部重组为“保镖队”，武器由日本军方提供。

5) 继续在国际租界制造恐怖活动，以使上海公共租界工部局陷入困境。
